title: Platonic
description: A Create-centric pack with late middle ages theming, made for use by Plato's Fun Hub.
body:
This is a heavily modified adaptation of the [Create Extra](https://modrinth.com/modpack/create-extra) pack by user [bondiben](https://modrinth.com/user/bondiben). All credit for the original pack goes to them.

This pack exists to provide a Create centered industrialization experience, with a Factorio inspired ore deposit system that forces your logistics networks to sprawl out over vast distances. Beyond that, it has minor late-middle-ages theming to encourage a brink of industrialization feel.
